## PC: taller top bar
- The top bar of the PC app is taller, so there is more room above and below the search field (12 px each side instead of 4)
- Home button, back/forward, Discord, profile and the window buttons stay centred in the taller bar
- Phones are unchanged

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
